name: Websites - Authorized - Webmail Domains [is]
description: Intent: Authorized webmail domains — populate with sanctioned corporate webmail surfaces (e.g., mail.google.com for a Gmail Workspace tenant, outlook.office.com for M365, internal-mail.acme.com). Drives the Authorized split on D1080 / M1070 (Internal webmail activity) and is negated to define the Unauthorized webmail surface on D1081 / M1071 / W1071 / B1070. Exclusions: do not add free Gmail / Outlook personal accounts; if you allow specific personal addresses under corporate license, scope by user-suffix instead.
